basis: The complete local HMLR freehold-index geometry audit found 1661 full valid polygons in the independently projected WUP-centered 1 km square, six equal-geometry pairs and 207 overlaps above 0.01 m², totaling 14089.256 m² pairwise overlap. The earlier approximate projected window returns 1662 with identical conflict totals. Native index polygons are indicative property extents; these overlapping published features cannot be admitted as exclusive 2D ground parcels without changing the source or representing its tenure/context model. No repair, deduplication, clipping or clean-subset selection was performed.
